extDescription.message: Look up a selected chemical formula or compound name and view its 3D structure and properties.

commandAnalyzeSelectionDescription.message: Analyze the selected text as a chemical formula

disclosureNote.message: Your input is sent to PubChem (U.S. National Center for Biotechnology Information) to perform the search.

privateNote.message: Search history is not saved in a private/incognito window.

statusEmptyQuery.message: Enter a formula, compound name, or SMILES string.

statusNotFound.message: No matching compound was found. Try a different spelling.

statusTimeout.message: The request timed out. Please try again.

statusError.message: An error occurred. Please check your network connection.

noStructureData.message: Structure data could not be retrieved

timeoutHint.message: If PubChem does not respond within this time, an error is shown instead.

historyMaxHint.message: Older entries beyond this number are removed automatically.

structureHint.message: Some compounds only have one type available on PubChem, in which case the other is used automatically.

autoHighlightLabel.message: Automatically detect and highlight chemical formulas on web pages

autoHighlightHint1.message: When enabled, formula-like patterns containing digits (e.g. H2O, C6H12O6) get a subtle underline. Hovering alone sends no data;

autoHighlightHint2.message: only clicking sends that text to PubChem (U.S. National Center for Biotechnology Information)

autoHighlightHint3.message: to show quick info. Formulas without digits (e.g. NaCl) are excluded to reduce false positives. Scanning the whole page may add a small amount of load on heavy pages.

shortcutConflictHint.message: If another extension already uses the same shortcut, it may not respond or may trigger a different action. Check and change the current assignment from the management screens below.

shortcutChromeInstruction.message: Chrome: open chrome://extensions/shortcuts in the address bar

shortcutFirefoxInstruction.message: Firefox: about:addons → "Extensions" → gear icon → "Manage Extension Shortcuts"

statusTooLong.message: The input is too long (max 200 characters). Check that you did not select a long passage by accident.

statusBusy.message: PubChem is busy right now. Please try again in a little while.

statusFormulaMatch.message: Matched by molecular formula. If several compounds (isomers) share this formula, one of them is shown.

permissionDenied.message: Access to all sites was not granted, so page highlighting stays off. Your other settings were saved.

highlightError.message: Lookup failed. Please click again in a moment

autoHighlightPermissionNote.message: When you enable this and save, the browser will ask you to allow access to all sites. Disabling it also revokes that permission automatically.

highlightCheckToolbar.message: Click the toolbar icon to see the result

advancedPropsSummary.message: Advanced properties (exact mass, XLogP, TPSA, etc.)
